title: Trade WETH - Open App
meta_description: trade weth through Uniswap with the verified Wrapped Ether contract, wallet quote review, and a direct app route to confirm onchain.
hero_h2: Swap into wrapped ether through a verified Ethereum route
hero_lead: trade weth through the Uniswap app with a wallet-connected route to the verified Ethereum WETH contract, quote review, and onchain confirmation.
what_is: WETH is Wrapped Ether, the ERC-20 representation of ETH used across Ethereum DeFi; ethereum.org explains why wrapping makes ETH work with ERC-20 contracts.

how.d: Use the official Uniswap web app route and confirm the domain is app.uniswap.org before connecting.
Choose an Ethereum wallet and keep ETH available for network gas.
Check the Ethereum WETH contract address: 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2.
Compare the quote, route, price impact, and approval details before signing onchain.

points.p: Use the Ethereum mainnet WETH contract shown on Etherscan, not a copied ticker from search or social posts.
Uniswap supports prefilled swap links, so the page can send users directly into the official web app with WETH selected.

points.h: ETH and WETH are different forms
points.p: ETH pays gas natively, while WETH is the ERC-20 wrapper used by many token contracts, DEX pools, and DeFi apps.

faq.a: You can use the official Uniswap web app route on app.uniswap.org and verify WETH against the Ethereum mainnet contract before connecting a wallet.

faq.q: Do I need ETH to trade weth?
faq.a: Yes. Ethereum transactions require ETH for gas, even when the asset you receive or approve is WETH.

faq.q: Which contract should I verify before I trade weth?
Is WETH the same as ETH when I trade weth?
faq.a: WETH represents ETH in ERC-20 form, but it is still a token contract interaction; review approvals, network, and wallet prompts carefully.

faq.q: Can I trade weth on other networks?
faq.a: Yes, but contract addresses differ by network. Always verify the address on the relevant official explorer before sending funds or approving a swap.
